infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Betty needs GPS to track your route and provide location-aware assistance.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Betty needs background GPS to continue monitoring your ride.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Betty needs motion data to detect lean angle and braking events.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Betty uses Bluetooth to connect to TPMS sensors and helmet comms.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Betty needs the microphone to hear your voice commands.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Betty uses speech recognition to understand your voice commands.
